column12: Update Effective Paths using Addon (desktop only)
Update Effective Paths using Web App

column3: Go to my IDS Master Sheet

column2:
STEP 1:
Click on the Copy Me link and create your copy of the IDS Master.

STEP 2:
Copy the ID (you will find it in the IDS tab) of your newly created sheet and paste it in the light gray area.

STEP 3:
Wait a little bit, the E4 cell will show "Loading...", and after few seconds it will display "#REF!". Click on the cell, and "Authorize" to let this sheet access the other one.
column11:
Mobile Users
If you are on mobile, you will not be able to do STEP 3. There is a workaround you can do still : You need to edit the viewing permissions to "anyone with the link" of all your IDs sheets


If you have any other trouble, let us know in the #effective-path Discord's channel.
I say us, but don't ask Fanta. Fanta hates IDS.

column2:
And that's it! The IDS are setup. You can now fill sub IDS in the IDS Master with sub IDS sheets (Laboratory, Workshop, ...) just like you did in here.
Every time you will change a value (let's say, a lab level in Laboratory Sheet) the change will be propagated to every other sheet using the IDS Master automatically.
It is, mostly for Cards, Modules, and Workshop. Everything else could technically be filled in the Master Sheet tab. But doing all of them is the recommended way of using that sheet
